# snipeit_category (Data Source)

Looks up a single category by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_category" "laptops" {
  name = "Laptops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the category. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the category. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `category_type` (String) Type of the category (`asset`, `accessory`, `consumable`, `component`, `license`).
- `checkin_email` (Boolean) Whether checkin/checkout emails are sent.
- `eula_text` (String) EULA text. Always null: the API does not return it.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `require_acceptance` (Boolean) Whether users must confirm acceptance of items in this category.
- `use_default_eula` (Boolean) Whether the instance-wide default EULA is used.
